Banner Text Generator

Wrap your text in decorative box-drawing borders — single, double, rounded or star styles.


    

  

  





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Type or paste your text (multiple lines OK).
  2. Choose a border style and padding.
  3. Press Generate.
  4. Copy the boxed text.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Which border styles are available?
Single (┌─┐), Double (╔═╗), Rounded (╭─╮) and Star (*) borders.
How is the box sized?
The box auto-sizes to the longest line, with adjustable padding.
Will the box display correctly everywhere?
The box uses standard Unicode box-drawing characters, which render correctly in terminals, code editors and most chat apps.
